name: Capgo
description: Live updates / OTA for CapacitorJS apps — ship JS/CSS fixes without waiting for App Store review, plus channels, rollback, native builds, and release automation (company-stated). Founded Nov 2021, EE. Team 2–5, bootstrapped. Founder Martin Donadieu. ~7,800 estimated users (founder-stated). SOC 2 Type II / SOC 3 / ISO 27001 (founder-stated). Stack: Astro, Vue, Supabase, Cloudflare, Resend, Stripe. DR 59.

mentions.evidence: ~$31.2k MRR, 1,130 active subscriptions, ~$36.6k L30, ~$546k all-time, ~5,000 users claimed, founded Nov 2021, Estonia. Last sync Oct 1, 2026.
mentions.indieAngle: Wrap a popular open framework's missing ops layer (OTA / CI) and charge for reliability + channels — classic boring developer infra.

mentions.evidence: ~$32,254 MRR (+6.8% L30), 1,167 active subscriptions, ~$33,650 L30 (−10.7%; snapshot ~$33,773), ~$101,893 last 3 months, ~$177,989 last 6 months, ~$289,169 last 12 months, ~$555,048 all-time, ~38,047 L30 visitors, ~$0.89 revenue/visitor, ~47% L30 profit margin. Revenue synced Oct 10, 2026 ~04:06 Warsaw (02:06 UTC).
mentions.indieAngle: If Capacitor is crowded, do the same OTA + channel + rollback story for Expo/React Native shops that refuse full Expo EAS, or sell a "hotfix channel" managed service for agencies that ship 10+ client apps and hate store review roulette.

whyItPrints: App Store review delay is a permanent tax on mobile teams. Capgo sells the missing "CodePush for Capacitor" wedge — devops glue, not a consumer AI app. ~1,167 subs at ~$32k MRR with ~47% L30 margin and ~38k L30 visitors is a real B2B tools business. MRR growing +6.8% even while L30 cash is −10.7%.
